in_marathi.name: Tuhin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tuhin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tuhin is a name derived from Sanskrit and Bengali origin meaning 'New Dawn'. It is a beautiful name for a boy, evoking feelings of renewal, hope, and the promise of a bright future.
